description: This PHP source file defines the Order API controller for OpenCart, providing various endpoints for managing orders, including setting customer info, addresses, shipping and payment methods, confirming orders, and handling order history.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class for handling Order API requests, providing methods to manage and process customer orders, addresses, methods, and order state.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main access point for ordering API; routes calls based on 'call' parameter and returns JSON responses.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Loads customer controller to set customer information in order.

methods.name: setPaymentAddress
methods.description: Loads payment address controller to set payment address info.

methods.name: setShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets shipping address, including cart validation.

methods.name: getShippingMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available shipping methods after necessary initializations.

methods.name: setShippingMethod
methods.description: Sets shipping method after preparing environment and extensions.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment methods with prerequisite checks.

methods.name: setPaymentMethod
methods.description: Sets payment method and loads order totals/extensions.

methods.name: extension
methods.description: Handles extension-related API calls, loading extension data based on provided code.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Retrieves current cart details, including products, totals, and shipping requirements.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a product to the cart and updates totals.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms an order after validating cart, customer, and address information, and creates/updates an order record.
